request.subject: Request for a copy of my contract and royalty statements
request.body:
Subject: request for a copy of my contract and royalty statements

Hello,

As part of tracking my income, I would be grateful if you could send me:
– a copy of my current artist / licence contract, including any amendments;
– my royalty statements for the last four half-years, broken down by platform and territory.

Thank you in advance.

{artistName}
